newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Alliance Capital mutual fund NAV up 52 pct.
newsitem.headline: India's Alliance Capital mutual fund NAV up 52 pct.

text.p: Alliance Capital Asset Management Company said on Friday the net asset value of its balanced mutual fund 'Alliance '95 Fund' rose 52 percent to 13.71 rupees on Thursday from 9.02 rupees on December 31, 1996
"We have got some very powerful numbers," Alliance Capital's country manager Ajai Kaul told Reuters, referring to the sharp rise in the fund's net asset value (NAV).
Alliance '95 is a balanced fund, with 60 percent of its corpus invested in equities and 40 percent in debt.
"We have beaten the BSE-200 index by a wide margin."
The rise in NAV is significant as 40 percent of Alliance '95 is invested in fixed income securities, Kaul said.
Alliance Capital Asset Management Company is the Indian affiliate of the U.S. fund manager Alliance Capital.
Kaul said Alliance Capital followed a strategy of staying away from economy-sensitive sectors in a year marked by an economic slowdown.
"We stayed away from cement and steel and focused on fast moving consumer goods, information technology and pharmaceuticals. These sectors are doing well," he said.
Alliance '95 has a corpus of about 470 million rupees.
